name: Mountainside RV Park
evidence: Campspot operator site map: all RV pads west of the park road, the loop road/parking spur between every pad and Muddy Creek (~10 m wide), so no creekside. Satellite 39.0284,-107.3648: creek ~15-35 m off across road through thin willow; no photo from a site shows the creek, so held at not waterfront.

name: State Forest State Park (North Michigan)
evidence: CPW per-site GIS + official site photos: RV sites 206, 207HD, 208 (north shore, ~18-32 m) and 227, 247 (~42-47 m) sit on open unused grass to the shore, no road between, lake in photos. Esri frames: open meadow, though north-shore pads aren't legible there. Tent 215-225 not counted; 201-205, 209 and the 231-241 loop not on water.

name: White Star Campground
evidence: rec.gov 232387: no Proximity to Water tags; photos of Sage loop sites 010, 012, 016 show Twin Lakes across open sage. Satellite 39.09,-106.36556: Sage loop 150 m+ back from shore with a road and open sage between; Valley loop farther. Valley loop photo sheets not viewed, not decisive.

name: Woodlake Park
evidence: Satellite 37.9974,-107.2923 (d .0015): upper loop pads east of the Lake Fork (~10-15 m wide), dense pine strip and an outer track between, ~20-30 m at nearest; lower loop in forest. Operator 'right along the river' is a lead only. Operator's per-site pins and photos NOT read: site returns 406 to the required UA, so pads aren't tied to site numbers.

name: Clear Creek RV Park
evidence: Satellite (winter, leaf-off) at 39.7532,-105.2321: south-row pads ~15-25 m from Clear Creek (~10 m wide) but a public trail and cottonwood line run between, so no creekside despite city 'Creek-side Full Hookup' $85 tier; creek visible through the trees. Mines ponds north are small and behind the loop road. No per-site photos or map found.

name: Crawford State Park (Clear Fork)
evidence: Satellite 38.6795,-107.5977 (d .0012, legible): RV pads 053-059 ~60+ m from high-water edge, past the 50 m apron limit, with a foot trail across; north pads 051-052 ~50 m from the cove across a track; 046-050 are tent sites. CPW photos of 051-053, 055, 057, 063-065 show the reservoir unscreened over open slope.

name: Gateway RV Park (Carbondale)
evidence: Town site map + satellite 39.4160,-107.2245: park is the gravel lot north of the Roaring Fork, ~270 m from the stored pin (south of the river). Nearest pads (15-19, up to 24 ft; 7-8 are 20 ft) ~45 m from water through continuous riparian trees and a ditch, so no riverfront. Town aerial photos show river in a gap near the bath house; no ground view.

name: Green Ridge Campground
evidence: Rec.gov 231861 photos viewed on sheets 0-3 (47 of 72 catalog sites have one): no water in any; 009, 059 show a raised embankment above the site, 002/003/070 a flat horizon. Satellite frames: shore road on riprap dike between all loops and the lake (front pads ~35-50 m); NID lists Shadow Mountain Dike; pads 0-1.5 m above pool, 1-3 m rise to the shore (not below pool; 2026-10-21 dam screen), but no view earned. 25 sites have no photo, incl. 006, 007.
